# pass.airat.top

Summary:
Pass.airat.top is a static, privacy-first generator for passwords, passphrases, usernames, and UUIDs (including UUID lists from 1 to 10,000). Everything runs locally in the browser using secure randomness.

Primary URL:
https://pass.airat.top

Key features:
- Password generator with length, character sets, minimums, and ambiguous-character filtering.
- Passphrase generator with configurable word count and separator.
- Username generator from a local word list with optional capitalization and numbers.
- UUID v4 generator with batch output from 1 to 10,000 values and one-click copy.
- One-click copy and regenerate actions.

Tech stack:
HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

Privacy:
No history or analytics; only local settings are stored. All generation happens locally.

Contact:
AiratTop — mail@airat.top
